name: Metro Interstate Traffic Volume Dataset
description: The Metro Interstate Traffic Volume dataset contains 48,204 hourly observations of westbound interstate traffic volume on I-94 between Minneapolis and St. Paul, Minnesota, paired with weather conditions and holiday indicators from 2012 to 2018. Donated by John Hogue to the UCI Machine Learning Repository (DOI: 10.24432/C5X60B), the dataset features 8 predictive attributes: holiday name, ambient temperature, rain accumulation, snow accumulation, cloud coverage, weather description, weather primary category, and date-time to evaluate the impact of adverse weather and holidays on arterial traffic flow.

provenance.collection_method: Automated loop detectors operated by the Minnesota Department of Transportation (MnDOT) matched with automated surface weather observations from Minneapolis-St Paul International Airport (KMSP).
provenance.curation_notes: A transportation traffic dataset with weather features, not a pure weather observation dataset.
